title: Channel
body:
Syntax: channel <chakra paper>

At level 10, Chakra Paper reveals your first nature. At level 25, channel a second Sheet of Chakra Paper to enter your Kage chamber and choose a different second nature. The sheet is consumed and the choice never starts automatically. Type 'choose <element>' or the element's name. You are safe from mobs and PvP, with only help and chat available until you choose. Type 'help <your first element>' to compare all four possible releases. Using a second Chakra Paper is required. At level 100, a further paper can reveal a third distinct nature. Clan bloodlines cannot also gain an elemental release.
